entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I just... I haven't even opened it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Michael Chen. The order number is VF-8812-45.

Thank you, Michael. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference matter?
Oh, it's not a fault. The thing is... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for this. But right after it arrived, my wife had a sudden medical emergency. It was awful.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope she's doing okay.

She is now, thank you. But she had to have emergency surgery and was in the hospital for over two weeks. And with my son's overseas deployment coming up, everything has just been... overwhelming. The box has just been sitting here, and honestly, we could really use that money back right now.
Wow, Michael, that sounds incredibly difficult. I completely understand. Please don't worry about the return. Let me just confirm the policy for you... one moment.

Okay, I've checked for you. It says right here in my system that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since your purchase was only 20 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure? I thought I might have missed the window with everything going on.

Absolutely sure. The 90-day policy is quite clear. I'm happy to help make one thing a little easier for you right now. I've just initiated the return, and I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label. Do you see it in your inbox?
Let me check... yes! It just came through. You have no idea what a help this is. Thank you so, so much, Sarah.
You are most welcome, Michael. I wish you and your family all the best. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Have a good rest of your day.
